in_hebrew.name: Fidellas
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fidellas הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'fidellos', meaning 'faithful, trusty, or reliable'. In Christianity, Fidellas could symbolize a faithful follower or disciple of Jesus.

in_greek.long_meaning: Fidellas είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek word 'fidellos', meaning 'faithful, trusty, or reliable'. In Christianity, Fidellas could symbolize a faithful follower or disciple of Jesus.

in_latin.name: Fidellas
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Faithful companion
